title: Virtual Assistant
description: Job Title: Virtual Assistant Job Type: Full time Location: Remote The Role We’re looking for a proactive, highly organized Virtual Assistant to support day-to-day operations across our distributed team. You’ll own general administrative work, team logistics, and gifting for our internal team, extended team, and clients. You should be resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership with minimal direction. What You’ll Do Own scheduling, research, documentation, and general administrative tasks. Maintain internal trackers, records, and operational information. Coordinate purchasing, vendors, shipping, expenses, and reimbursements. Support onboarding, team logistics, and ad hoc requests. Own gifting operations across our team and clients. Source gifts and manage ordering, personalization, shipping, and delivery. Track gifting budgets, recipient information, orders, and vendors. Anticipate needs and drive tasks through completion. What We're Looking For 3+ years in administrative support, operations, or a similar role. Excellent organization and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication. High ownership, reliability, and follow-through. Strong research and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment. Good judgment when handling sensitive information. Preferred Experience in a startup, technology company, or distributed team. Experience with gifting, vendors, purchasing, or logistics. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack and project management tools. Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and automate repetitive tasks. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Data Entry Keyer
description: Role Title: Data Entry Keyer Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Data Entry Keyers to contribute to a customer's advanced AI benchmark project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Design and produce expert-level evaluation tasks that simulate real-world data entry and validation challenges for AI agents. Construct and curate large, complex datasets—including CSVs, PDFs, spreadsheets, and technical documents filled with realistic errors such as malformed records, missing data, and inconsistent formats. Define the correct final state for each task, specifying the exact error cases and reconciliation requirements that an AI must address. Author detailed grading rubrics (35+ criteria) for assessment of AI agent outputs, focusing on both accuracy and completeness in error detection. Ensure all authored tasks mirror the authentic complexity and standards of highly regulated or audit-sensitive environments. Collaborate asynchronously through precise written and verbal communication to iterate and refine evaluation materials. Preferred Qualifications Extensive experience in data entry, quality assurance, or data validation within regulated or audit-sensitive domains such as healthcare claims, finance back office, or legal operations. Demonstrated ability to achieve and document high accuracy standards, including measurable error rates and outcomes. Strong skills in detecting and analyzing data inconsistencies, silent truncations, and formatting irregularities across diverse file types. Proficient written English, enabling clear drafting of complex evaluation tasks and comprehensive grading rubrics. Exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined, process-oriented work style. Experience contributing to projects with high stakes for compliance, accuracy, or data integrity is highly valued. Comfort working independently and communicating proactively within remote, distributed project environments. Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas
